root_cause.text: The driver trusts firmware-reported frame_size without validating it against the fixed-size destination buffer (`item->iocb`, 64 bytes), allowing a buffer overflow when frame_size exceeds 64 bytes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit cap checks (`if (total_bytes > sizeof(item->iocb.iocb)) total_bytes = sizeof(item->iocb.iocb);`) in both `qla27xx_copy_fpin_pkt()` and `qla27xx_copy_multiple_pkt()`, and the CVE description confirms that without this check, memcpy overflows the `iocb` member boundary when frame_size > 64 bytes.
